records.title: Improving Higher Educational Institutions (HEIs)
details: (c) It was inter-alia stated that UGC has also constituted a Committee on Accreditation of Higher Educational Institutions in order to examine the existing documentation/verification processes of NAAC/NBA for simplification/rationalization and firm up an incentive-based, facilitation-oriented approach to be adopted to encourage HEIs to undertake accreditation.
